title: There Is No Other God That Can Deliver
subtitle: Daniel 1–7 · Church History · Hymns

across.clue: “There is a God in heaven that revealeth ___” (Dan. 2:28)
Michael, “the father of all, the prince of all,” per latter-day revelation (D&C 27:11)
Den into which Daniel was cast (Dan. 6:16)
Great one in the dream, its head of fine gold (Dan. 2:31–32)
Elect lady told to make a selection of sacred hymns (D&C 25:11)
King who made a great feast to a thousand of his lords (Dan. 5:1)
God sent one to shut the lions’ mouths (Dan. 6:22)
Plain where the golden image was set up (Dan. 3:1)
How the weighed king was found (Dan. 5:27)

down.clue: “Cut out without hands,” it became a great mountain (Dan. 2:34–35)
What Daniel asked to eat in place of the king’s meat (Dan. 1:12)
“Our God whom we serve is able to ___ us” (Dan. 3:17)
Captive who “purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself” (Dan. 1:8)
One like this came with the clouds of heaven (Dan. 7:13)
The ___ of Days did sit, his garment white as snow (Dan. 7:9)
What the God of heaven sets up, which “shall never be destroyed” (Dan. 2:44)
“The form of the ___ is like the Son of God” (Dan. 3:25)
